```r
p <- 0.45
N <- 1000
x <- [sample](https://rdrr.io/r/base/sample.html)([c](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)(0, 1), size = N, replace = TRUE, prob = [c](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)(1 - p, p))
x_hat <- [mean](https://rdrr.io/r/base/mean.html)(x)
se_hat <- [sqrt](https://rdrr.io/r/base/MathFun.html)(x_hat*(1 - x_hat)/N)
[c](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)(x_hat - 1.96*se_hat, x_hat + 1.96*se_hat)
#> [1] 0.400 0.462
```

```r
[set.seed](https://rdrr.io/r/base/Random.html)(1)
N <- 1000
B <- 10000
p <- 0.45
inside <- [replicate](https://rdrr.io/r/base/lapply.html)(B, {
 x <- [sample](https://rdrr.io/r/base/sample.html)([c](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)(0,1), size = N, replace = TRUE, prob = [c](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)(1 - p, p))
 x_hat <- [mean](https://rdrr.io/r/base/mean.html)(x)
 se_hat <- [sqrt](https://rdrr.io/r/base/MathFun.html)(x_hat*(1 - x_hat)/N)
 p >= x_hat - 1.96*se_hat & p <= x_hat + 1.96*se_hat
})
[mean](https://rdrr.io/r/base/mean.html)(inside)
#> [1] 0.948
```
